title: Implement a nonnegative sparse image encoder
prompt: Apply a nonnegative sparse encoder relu(X@W.T+b). Keep values strictly above threshold, then optionally retain top-k coordinates per row with stable index tie-breaking. Return dense sparse codes and positive-nonzero counts. Hard masks are an inference/training-core choice, not a smooth sparsity penalty.
